whenToUse: Lists with thousands of rows or more, such as logs or order history.
All rows have the same height.
whenNotToUse: There are a few hundred rows or fewer (just rendering them is simpler).
People need find in page (Ctrl+F) to search the content.
Row heights vary (it gets complicated, since heights must be measured).

alternatives.name: Load More
alternatives.reason: Loading only as much as needed.

accessibility: Many rows aren't in the DOM, so each row announces its position in the whole with aria-setsize and aria-posinset.
The scroll area is a named region that takes focus and scrolls with the keyboard.
A few extra rows are drawn above and below so fast scrolling shows fewer blank rows.
The browser's find can't reach off-screen rows, so provide a search feature too.
